scripts.clean-agents: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); function clean(dir) { if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return; fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).forEach(e => { const p = path.join(dir, e.name); if (e.isDirectory()) clean(p); else if (e.isFile() && !e.name.endsWith('.md')) { fs.unlinkSync(p); } }); } clean('.agents');"
scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit
